glosses: crystal, cut glass (relating to glass with a high refractive index or to fine glassware made of such glass)
crystalline, crystal-clear (resembling fine glassware; clear and transparent)
связанный, соотносящийся по значению с существительным хрусталь

examples.text: Характерные для вятичей хрустальные шарообразные бусы чередуются в ожерельях с сердоликовыми бипирамидальными общерусскими, т. е., иначе говоря, короткие белые бусы чередуются с длинными красными.

A piece of glimmering, shining mineral resembling ice or glass.
A fine type of glassware, or the material used to make it.

examples.text: He tells me he's been shooting crystal, which I already pretty much know because he does not bother to keep his sleeves rolled down over the needle tracks.

examples.text: Its ceiling was crystal, around on the wall / Thickly studded were rubies and diamonds rare; / But purer than crystal, and brighter than all / Of the jewels adorning her glittering hall, / Was the mermaiden languishing there.
The walls were crystal, and they seemed to have hundreds of different-colored lights shifting behind them.
The uneven floor was crystal as well, as if there once had been huge crystals jutting up here, too, but ones that had been broken away and the surface crudely adzed.

examples.text: Не бледней, моя печальная, от вина. Светит нам звезда хрустальная из окна.
